sentences.en: He speaks, most cleverly, to his brief, but he will not go outside it.
sentences.vi: Anh ấy nói, một cách khéo léo nhất, với bản tóm tắt của mình, nhưng anh ấy sẽ không đi ra ngoài nó.

sentences.en: Either she had never seen him angry or he had cleverly concealed it - like every other emotion.
sentences.vi: Hoặc cô chưa bao giờ thấy anh tức giận hoặc anh đã khéo léo che giấu điều đó - như mọi cảm xúc khác.

sentences.en: Prince Charles cleverly temporized with both powers.
sentences.vi: Thái tử Charles khôn khéo hòa hợp cả hai quyền lực.

sentences.en: These are cleverly employed in order to heighten the impression of its instability.

sentences.en: That domestic misfortune was cleverly exploited by King Milan's enemies in the country and abroad, and did him more harm than all his political mistakes.

sentences.en: And Bellocchio cleverly weaves images and sounds, as well as news footage and old movie clips to make it all seem frighteningly authentic.
